//: Anti-detect thresholds for the historical Patchright compatibility harness (T-005). Only sannysoft.maxFailed is a detector threshold read by run.mjs. WebRTC has a synthetic flag/control check but no real proxy, while CreepJS and coherence are measured or enforced elsewhere. Release evidence is graded by detector-matrix.mjs and the native real-GPU gate, not this file alone.

sannysoft.note: GATED only in the historical Patchright compatibility job. That control browser exposes host WebGL, so it allows two WebGL cells. Native Lobium release evidence permits no Sannysoft failed cells; this allowance must never be cited as the product bar.

creepjs.note: MEASUREMENT ONLY — not enforced by run.mjs. CreepJS runs only when LOBSTER_CREEPJS=1 and its trust/lies are reported in detectorMatrix, never compared to these numbers (JS deep-surface spoofing is itself the tell CreepJS detects, so trust stays low until Lobium's native patches land). minTrustScore/maxLies are the target for the Lobium build, not a current gate.

webrtc.note: NOT A PROXIED-PROFILE GATE. run.mjs checks local mDNS candidates on its unproxied compatibility profile and runs separate throwaway control/suppression browsers to prove the Chromium flag can suppress STUN. It reports webrtcLeakProtected=null because it never launches the exact product profile through a real proxy. Release evidence must compare expected proxy egress, observed TCP egress, ICE candidates, and a no-proxy negative control using detector-matrix.mjs.

coherence.note: MEASUREMENT ONLY in this harness — run.mjs derives a coherent fingerprint but does not re-run a coherence gate against maxIssues. Coherence is enforced upstream by the @lobster/fingerprint unit tests (validateFingerprintCoherence over the 50-seed x OS x engine sweep).
